summary:
超微EPS超預期、營收年增37.85%，資料中心與AI晶片動能強。
• EPS 1.37美元，超出預期1.29美元，驚喜幅度5.82%。
• 營收102.5億美元，年增37.85%，成長動能顯著。
• 資料中心（EPYC CPU與Instinct GPU）為核心成長引擎。
• MI系列AI加速器持續搶佔市占，挑戰競爭對手。
• 客戶端與嵌入式業務逐步回穩。
ai_view:
訊號正向：營收年增37.85%且EPS超預期，資料中心與AI加速器雙引擎驅動成長。短中期股價由MI系列GPU放量與市占擴張帶動，動能明確。但182倍本益比已充分反映樂觀，容錯空間有限。追蹤指標：資料中心營收年增、AI GPU出貨與訂單能見度、毛利率走勢、客戶端復甦力道。能否在AI市場持續擴大市占，是支撐高估值的關鍵。

需留意：本益比182倍極高，估值對成長放緩高度敏感。；AI GPU市場面臨主導者強勢競爭。；毛利率提升速度須匹配高估值預期。

summary_en:
AMD beats EPS with 37.85% revenue growth on strong data-center and AI chips.
• EPS of $1.37 beat the $1.29 estimate by 5.82%.
• Revenue of $10.25B grew 37.85% YoY with notable momentum.
• Data center (EPYC CPUs and Instinct GPUs) is the core growth engine.
• MI-series AI accelerators keep gaining share against competitors.
• Client and embedded segments are gradually stabilizing.

ai_view_en:
Signal positive: 37.85% revenue growth and an EPS beat reflect dual data-center and AI-accelerator engines. Near to mid-term, the stock is driven by MI-series GPU ramp and share gains, with clear momentum. But a 182x P/E fully prices in optimism, leaving little margin for error. Track: data-center revenue growth, AI GPU shipments and order visibility, gross-margin trend, and client recovery. Sustained AI share gains are key to supporting the rich valuation.

Watch：A 182x P/E is very high and sensitive to any growth slowdown.; The AI GPU market faces intense competition from the dominant player.; Margin expansion must keep pace with elevated valuation expectations.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS驚喜+5.82%，營收年增37.85%，資料中心GPU與EPYC續強。
